Operations Manager — Halvorsen Freight AS (Bergen, hybrid)

About the role
You'll keep our Bergen terminal running smoothly day to day. That means owning the relationship with our 30+ carriers and suppliers, negotiating and renewing their contracts, and making sure invoices are checked against delivery records before they reach Finance.

You will
- Lead a team of 6 shift coordinators
- Run the weekly ops meeting and report KPIs (on-time departures, damage claims, cost per pallet) to the COO
- Manage vendor contracts and renewals with support from Legal
- Approve carrier invoices up to NOK 500,000

You have
- 5+ years in logistics or warehouse operations, at least 2 managing people
- Comfort with numbers and spreadsheets
- Norwegian and English

We offer a competitive salary, pension, 5 weeks' holiday and a company bike. Apply with your CV by 15 November.
